text:
I have completed the requirements analysis for the **Entity former names and rename redirects** feature (`20261104-101757-feature-new-entity-former-names`) and written `.sdlc/runs/20261104-101757-feature-new-entity-former-names/requirements.md`.

### Summary of `requirements.md`
- **In scope (1–9)** & **Out of scope (1–5)**: Captures the approved boundaries across `@backstage/catalog-model`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog-backend`, `@backstage/catalog-client`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog-react`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog`, `@backstage/plugin-techdocs`, docs, API reports, and changesets.
- **Functional requirements (FR-1.1 through FR-6.2)**: Specifies per-module requirements covering the former-names annotation declaration, stitch-time indexing and orphan/deletion cleanup, live-entity precedence, anti-hijacking conflict resolution, `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog` permission checks, OpenAPI & `CatalogClient` lookup support (plus `InMemoryCatalogClient` and `catalogApiMock`), and replace-navigation with rename notices on both Catalog (legacy & alpha) and TechDocs routes.
- **Non-functional requirements (NFR-1 through NFR-5)**: Covers zero extra query cost on direct hits, indexed database lookups, PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite compatibility, non-disclosure of unauthorized redirect targets, and repo conventions.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Documents data sensitivity, `catalog.entity.read` enforcement across allow/deny/conditional/conflict scenarios, and audit logging.
- **Acceptance criteria (AC-1 through AC-6)**: Provides executable test and `yarn tsc` commands for all affected packages.
